response.text: I'll start by verifying the key claims: journal balance, AP-to-GL tie-out, duplicates, and closed-period postings.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."PRD_ID", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."PRD_ID" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT")<>SUM(l."CR_AMT") ORDER BY 1

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS ap_dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS ap_cr FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING COALESCE(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),0)-COALESCE(SUM(l."CR_AMT"),0) <> 0 OR SUM(l."DR_AMT") IS NULL OR SUM(l."DR_AMT") <> i."INV_AMT" ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100

SELECT UPPER(TRIM(LTRIM(TRIM("VEND_CD"),'0'))) AS vk, TRIM(LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER("INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0')) AS nk, COUNT(*) AS n, ARRAY_AGG("INV_ID") AS ids FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT" ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100

SELECT p."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" GROUP BY p."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING SUM(p."PAY_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT" OR i."STAT_CD"<>'P' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100
SELECT DISTINCT l."ACCT_CD", c."ACCT_CD" AS coa, c."ACTV_FLG" FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL OR c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
